title: Talon's Shadow
tagline: Gather the fruit. Watch the shadow. Slip away over any edge.
teaser: A snake, a field of fruit, a bird of prey overhead and a hunter of the place on foot. Every fruit you carry slows you; rival snakes share the harvest, and running into one ends you. Clear eight regions to end the expedition, or take on five challenges, from filling the field to King Drift.

manPage.synopsis: snake — gather fruit under a circling bird of prey and slip away over any edge before its dive finds you.
manPage.description: The owner's earlier fancy-web port of snake: you are the snake now, slithering after fruit while an eagle (an owl by night) circles, locks on and dives, its shadow the only warning. Around it, an expedition through eight regions with their own birds, harvests, rival snakes and letter-shaped fences; every fruit carried makes you slower and the bird hungrier, a bare field makes it ravenous, and clearing Midnight ends the expedition. Three contracts a region with a stamp each, a field book, records and a Daily Flight. A hunter of each region stalks on foot and pecks, rival snakes that run into you are cut off (and you, if you run into them), and Space sheds the tail as a decoy. Five challenges stand apart: Fill the Field, King Drift, Coil, Survival and Courier. A second interpretation beside the collection's own snake.

howToPlay: Steer with W A S D or the arrow keys and gather fruit; once the last fruit is gone, leave over any edge.
Keep clear of the bird's red ring and the hunter's peck, and never run into a rival's body.
Every fruit slows you; bring home a region's goal to clear it. Space sheds your tail as a decoy.

cronGoals.label: Bring home {n} fruit in Talon's Shadow
